One Goal store; boundGoals is an index into same records. PlanRun/To-Do/scoped units/schedules/artifact metadata stay with shared owners. New orderExport store owns only task input, attempts, outputs and evidence.
Existing six Goal commands and cmd.chat.plan.build correspondence above; no build_as_goal command invented; local-only exercises and clock explicit.
CAS Goal token + exact Plan admission snapshot + frozen route; text bounds; eligibility; typed refusal paths; no actual native permission service.
Each row names the actual handler; atomic tests patch its real seams after actual writes, not a replacement model.
PM56_EXT registrations and existing preSend hooks; action collision gate on each fresh browser; no changes to production wiring files.
Public Demo Studio seeds only; ordinary Send, More, Build, Goal Activity, Revise and scheduling controls own work; guide can be dismissed.
Goal <-> Plan; Goal/Plan <-> To-Do outcomes; quota/window -> fenced same owner; branch/rewind -> Goal identity; artifacts open/download stored exact output.

Session-local continuation/admission/cancellation/item evidence receipts demonstrated. Shared working renderer consumes actual owner projection. No EventRecord, Event Authority or native ObservableWork registration proved.
In-memory accepted checkpoint/rebind and stale-generation rejection only; existing schedule local storage is not durable host execution. Native restart/transfer/V1 migration remains open.
B15 real-handler cases, ordinary desktop/900/700 journeys, Deep identity/Step Rail/Activity tests, cumulative B1-B14 reruns, actual extracted installer; final reports identify exact bytes.
Original final-build captures/logs separated from intermediate failures and from ten recovered historical images. Motion capture does not itself imply smooth painting.
